name: Anatolia
weapons: Reason magic (Fire, Glass Wheel up to Thoron)
personality: A cool rationalist who keeps emotional distance and sometimes offends people without meaning to.
story: A Mediator from Kunlun in the west, nicknamed the Mysterious Bride for her appearance, who fights to save her people. She joins in Part III on every route.

personalSkill.name: Celestial Flow
personalSkill.effect: Avo+3. At Lv20 gains Continuum: restores 5 HP when avoiding an attack (10 HP at Lv35).

joins: Automatically in Part III: Salvation, First Section, on all routes. Guides advise completing her Part I paralogue to be safe.

build.notes: Ursa's Right Claw and the Turmoil Mask brake her gauge near the top. Join class ?.

guide.role: Dodge caster: Glass Wheel and Thoron from range, Continuum heals on every dodge
guide.summary: A fast Black Magic caster for flier and mage maps: Glass Wheel hits Def and is effective vs fliers. Her attacks fill a Celestial Wells gauge and cursed gear drains it, so put on Ursa's Right Claw or the Turmoil Mask only near the top, to hold Overblaze without Burst.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: Glass Wheel or Thoron from 2-3 tiles, ending where only bows and mages reach her (Dodge+ and Read the Winds). Enemy phase: Continuum+ heals 10 per dodge. Boss turn: Blaze Arts from Overblaze.
keys: Train Gauntlet B at the Arena (Warrior course) from Sec 2: the Claw needs it.
Reach Black A by Lv 45 for Druid: Mage Training weeks, then fights.
Gauge at 10-11: swap in the Claw (Curse 1, Wt 1) for one combat to brake.
Pair her with Leda: Song of Madness confuses, the Turmoil Mask hits x1.5.
Boon maps: cast from within 2 of Eshmel.
watch: Weight: Glass Wheel 7 + Electron Agitator 5 = 12 over Bld ?. Enemy phase: Dodge Gauntlets 3 + 5 = 8, Avo +10. Turmoil Mask (3) comes off first.
Gauge: Celestial Wells; Burst at full (12?) drops Overblaze and halves max HP. Seven-Star Dragon needs 11.
Undead: Claw and Mask can zero her hit (Offset Curse). Undead maps: both off.
Lashing Rapture: Cai's Ch 6 chest only. In the Reliquary only if that save held it (?); plan without it.
Join class and level ?: Continuum+ needs Lv 35 (Continuum below).

decisions.pick: Ovate on join, Druid at Lv 45 (Black A)
decisions.why: Mag 50 is her best growth, and both classes keep Gauntlet for the Claw. War Monk and The Godhand trade Black Magic for White, where she only has Heal and Silence.
decisions.else: War Monk (Aurora's request) if Black A stalls

decisions.pick: The Claw from Leda's Lv 20+ Noctula; Theodora's copy stays stored
decisions.why: The only cursed gauntlet, and Wt 1: the brake costs no AS. Violent Claw (3 hits at 50%) is a finisher; Glass Wheel stays the damage.
The Avatar is Sirocco's (one holder); The Godhand needs Gauntlet S and drops her Black Magic.
